steps.en: Clone the repo and copy the defence skill folders into your skills directory
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，把防御 skill 文件夹拷进 skills 目录

steps.en: Ask Claude Code to scan what is installed
steps.zh: 让 Claude Code 扫一遍已装的 skill
steps.code: Scan my installed skills for security issues

steps.en: Matches each line of SKILL.md and scripts/ against fixed patterns; rates the skill by its worst hit
steps.zh: 逐行比对 SKILL.md 和脚本的固定模式，按最重命中定级

steps.en: Judge each hit yourself, then record a fingerprint baseline of the skills you accept
steps.zh: 自己判断每条命中，再给认可的 skill 记一份指纹基线

steps.en: Before later sessions, ask for an integrity check
steps.zh: 之后开会话前，让它做一次完整性检查

steps.en: Re-hashes every skill file and lists what was modified, added or deleted since the baseline
steps.zh: 重算每个 skill 文件的哈希，列出基线之后被改、新增、删除的文件

value.en: A named list of suspicious lines and of files changed since your review, instead of rereading every skill by hand; the verdict is still yours
value.zh: 拿到可疑行清单和“审过之后改了哪些文件”的清单，不用逐个重读 skill；结论仍由你下

sources: README.md Quick Start: Install Defense Skills (git clone, cp -r skills/security-monitor  ~/.claude/skills/security-monitor; 'Scan my installed skills for security issues'; 'Verify skill integrity') at commit 5180a467, read 2026-10-08
skills/security-monitor/scripts/scan_skills.py (scan_skill_directory reads SKILL.md and files directly under scripts/, overall_risk = max severity)
